paṭikelanā.p: [Pati+kele+yu+ā] (thī) CL=8 adore,love, fond and be strongly attached to it again and again.

DOP: paṭikelanā paṭikeḷanā f. [paṭi + kelanā], excessive concern; Sv 286, 13 (imassa vā pūtikāyassa kelanā ~ā ti evaṃvuttacāpalyavirahito, Ee so; Be paṭikeḷanā; Ce patikeḷanā; Se parikeḷanā) = Ps III 422, 17 ( Be, Se so; Ce kelāyanā patikelanā; Ee kelāyanā ~ā) quoting Vibh 351, 31 ( Be, Ee, Se parikeḷanā; Ce parikeḷāyanā); — see also parikeḷanā.
